rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice: a body part can 痕 when it feels itchy, and an irritant can 痕 someone when it causes itching.

example.english: After eating seafood, my whole body starts to itch.
example.traditional: 我食完海鮮之後，成身都好痕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 hoi2 sin1 zi1 hau6 seng4 san1 dou1 hou2 han4

rows.note: Use this when the person physically scratches the itchy area for relief, such as scratching the neck.

example.english: If your neck starts to itch, scratch it instead of holding back.
example.traditional: 頸痕就抓吓啦，唔好忍住。
example.jyutping: geng2 han4 zau6 zaau2 haa5 laa1 m4 hou2 jan2 zyu6

rows.note: Use this for an urge or temptation to do something, rather than for a physical itch.

example.english: Seeing it so cheap, I have an itch to buy it.
example.traditional: 見到咁平，我真係心郁想買。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 gam3 peng4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 sam1 juk1 soeng2 maai5
